name: better-notes
title: Better Notes
description: A floating markdown notepad, one hotkey away. Open source and extensible.
author: wesleybldc

commands.name: toggle-notes
commands.title: Toggle Better Notes
commands.description: Show or hide the floating Better Notes window.

commands.name: create-note
commands.title: Create Note
commands.description: Create a note from text, the search bar, or the selected text, and open it.

commands.name: search-notes
commands.title: Search Notes
commands.description: Search, open, copy, pin, and manage your notes.

commands.name: recently-deleted
commands.title: Recently Deleted Notes
commands.description: Restore deleted notes or remove them permanently.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Better Notes Menu Bar
commands.description: Pinned and recent notes in the menu bar.

scripts.prebuild: npm run build:editor && npm run build:helper
scripts.predev: npm run build:editor && npm run build:helper
